result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: low text contrast on a promo banner and an abruptly clipped label in a horizontal list.

issues.description: White text inside the promotional banner lacks sufficient contrast against the pale green background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text color or increase the banner background contrast to improve readability.

issues.description: The restaurant title on the rightmost visible item under 'Fastest near you' clips abruptly at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add right padding to the scrollable container or truncate text with an ellipsis.
